## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Update the command documentation so users who omit `--timeout` can accurately predict how long a slow request can wait.

## Changes

The CLI raises the default request timeout from 30 to 60 seconds, and the parser test now expects 60. An explicit `--timeout` still overrides the default.

## Important

- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the documented default timeout — When you omit `--timeout`, the parser now uses `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, leaving `README.md:3` incorrect where it says “Requests time out after 30 seconds”. — Users relying on the README can underestimate how long a slow request can wait by 30 seconds. — Fix: Change the documented default to 60 seconds in `README.md:3`.
